note.windows: The first build takes 15 to 30 minutes and about 3 GB. Python, LLVM and the Visual Studio Build Tools with CMake (about 3 GB) are installed if they are missing; Windows asks for permission. Choose the Windows 95 SimCity 2000 disc (CD Collection or Special Edition), its .iso, or a folder with its SIMCITY.EXE.
note.default: The first build takes 15 to 30 minutes and about 3 GB, and plays under Wine. It needs clang, lld, llvm, cmake, ninja and wine from your package manager (it says which are missing, with the command), and downloads Microsoft's C runtime and Windows SDK with xwin: building accepts Microsoft's licence for them (https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=2086102). Choose the Windows 95 SimCity 2000 disc, its .iso, or a folder with its SIMCITY.EXE.
